title: Recall scoping design review
summary_text: Reviewed per-session recall scoping. Decided the inject hook must pass cwd so recall scopes per session like capture does. Open question: caching the per-repo lock.
summary_markdown:
## Decisions
- The inject hook **must send cwd** so recall scopes per-session, mirroring capture.

## Open questions
- Whether to cache the per-repo lock or resolve it on every recall.

transcript.text: Recall is hitting the empty default graph instead of the per-repo group. We need the inject hook to send cwd.
Right, capture already scopes per session by cwd. Inject should match it exactly so the two halves agree.
Let's also decide whether the per-repo lock should be cached or resolved fresh each recall.
